_description: Provenance record for data/llm_cache.json. Updated automatically when bun run benchmark:llm populates the cache.
note: Cache is empty. Run `OPENAI_API_KEY=<key> bun run benchmark:llm` to populate with real gpt-4o-mini inference. Estimated cost: ~$1-3 USD for 200-500 Surface D threads. Once populated, all subsequent bun run benchmark:llm runs replay from cache deterministically.
howToVerify: 1. Check this file — realLlmEntries must be > 0
2. Open data/llm_cache.json — every entry must have isFallback: false and a tokenUsage block
3. Run bun run benchmark:llm — it will report cache hit count, live call count, fallback count
4. Fallback count must be 0 for the accuracy figure to be a valid LLM benchmark result
